Presenting MUJHKO APNE GALE LAGA LO AYE MERE HUMRAHI FULL VIDEO SONG from HAMRAHI movie starring Rajendra Kumar, Jamuna, Mahmood, Shashikala, Lalita Pawar in lead roles, released in 1963. The song is sung by Mubarak Begum, Mohammed Rafi and music is given by Shankar-Jaikishan, music is available exclusively on Gaane Sune Ansune.
Song: MUJHKO APNE GALE LAGA LO AYE MERE HUMRAHI
